messages:
Priya: FYI  Rescue plan for Solara QBR (renewal ~5w). Need: 90s exec ask, 1-pg risk brief, onboarding gap slide, and a finance-friendly SKU appendix. Who can grab which? :wave:
Marco: Ill do the 90s ask + ARR exposure. Will include a conservative ask and a stretch ask.
Jen: Ill take onboarding health. Current activation 63% with 5 blocked connectors; will list owners and ETA.
Kofi: Support/Billing feedback pushed risk up. Top asks: clearer tuning recipes and a billing SKU map for their finance team. Ill redact quotes and add NPS trend.
Priya: @Kofi paste two anonymized snippets we can use on the brief.
Kofi: Snippets (anonymized): "Responses degrade after token limit change" and "Invoices don't map cleanly to API calls."
Marco: Uploaded a rev-impact sketch to Drive: https://drive.redwood/qbr/solara-ask. At-risk ARR est ~$110k; downside ~$35k.
Jen: Onboarding fixes: weekly concierge calls x2, prebuilt connector templates, and a prioritized bug fix list. Will show TTF and blocked-item owners.
Priya: Keep total slides <=4. Include fallback offers: 1) 4-hr concierge + config sprint, 2) Dedicated eval (include cost delta). Bring two mitigations per risk to the dry run.
EBR-bot: Reminder: Dry run scheduled Mon 9:00am PT  invites sent to execs and AMs.
Marco: Confirmed  will share 90s script by EOD.
Kofi: Confirmed  will add anonymized quotes and NPS snippet.
Jen: Confirmed  slide draft by 3pm.
Priya: Thanks team  Ill collate slides and prep the one-pager tracker. See you Monday. :calendar:
